title: Offline synthetic boot-attestation audit service - replayable conformance cases

cases.name: happy-path-full
cases.description: A valid full-baseline proof issues a full-access credential and advances the counter.

cases.name: chain-missing-module
cases.description: Dropping a baseline-required module is MISSING_MODULE (chain covers the whole boot).

cases.name: chain-wrong-order
cases.description: Two modules at each other's positions are MODULE_POSITION_MISMATCH.

cases.name: chain-sequence-order
cases.description: Renumbered-but-shuffled sequence numbers are CHAIN_SEQ_ORDER.

cases.name: chain-digest-tampered
cases.description: A recomputed chain whose kernel digest differs from the baseline is DIGEST_MISMATCH.

cases.name: chain-extra-and-misplaced-critical
cases.description: An undefined module is EXTRA_MODULE; a false critical claim is CRITICAL_MODULE_UNKNOWN.

cases.name: cross-tenant-same-modules
cases.description: Tenant B publishes a baseline with identical module names; tenant A's device may not use it.

cases.name: tampered-signature
cases.description: A mutated witness signature is WITNESS_SIGNATURE_INVALID; a re-linked chain is CHAIN_LINK_MISMATCH.

cases.name: challenge-exactly-expired
cases.description: The window is half-open: at expires_at-1 accepted, at expires_at CHALLENGE_EXPIRED, later too.

cases.name: recovery-low-privilege
cases.description: A valid recovery proof only ever yields diagnostic-readonly, and still advances the counter.

cases.name: recovery-cannot-get-general-access
cases.description: Asking for full-access on a recovery baseline is denied and the counter is not consumed.

cases.name: recovery-cannot-lower-full-floor
cases.description: A recovery baseline may not declare a full-privilege floor below the group minimum.

cases.name: counter-rollback
cases.description: A counter at or below the watermark is COUNTER_ROLLBACK; recovery advances the same watermark.

cases.name: new-baseline-supersedes-old-proof
cases.description: Publishing v2 supersedes v1; a proof already measured against v1 then fails closed.

cases.name: revoked-baseline
cases.description: A revoked baseline denies with BASELINE_REVOKED even to a fresh, well-formed proof.

cases.name: baseline-publication-rules
cases.description: Bad signature, version conflict and floors below the group minimum are refused.

cases.name: generation-rotation
cases.description: Rotation revokes credentials, invalidates challenges and preserves the counter watermark.

cases.name: reregistration-keeps-watermark
cases.description: Re-registering never resets the anti-rollback watermark.

cases.name: request-id-idempotency
cases.description: The same request id replays the stored receipt; different content conflicts.

cases.name: challenge-single-use
cases.description: A second, independently valid proof for the same challenge is CHALLENGE_CONSUMED.
